exposure: Apgar score at the first minute of birth
cohort: Women who had a vaginal delivery at Shahrara Teaching Hospital in Kabul, Afghanistan, during the first six months of 2023 were included in the study.
finding: Higher parity was associated with lower odds of episiotomy, while a longer duration of labor during stage 2 was associated with higher odds of episiotomy.
mod_finding: Higher parity was associated with lower odds of episiotomy and a longer duration of labor during stage 2 was associated with higher odds of episiotomy, directly impacting the prevalence of this birth intervention.
